deficits.evidence: No footway visible on the left side of the road, people must walk in the roadway.
deficits.suggestion: Construct a continuous, usable sidewalk along the left side of the road to provide a safe walking space for pedestrians.

deficits.evidence: Informal path on the right side is partly blocked by parked vehicles and other obstructions.
deficits.suggestion: Remove obstructions and widen the informal path on the right side to ensure it is fully usable for pedestrians.

deficits.evidence: Uneven and broken sections on the informal path on the right side pose trip hazards.
deficits.suggestion: Repair and level the informal path on the right side to eliminate trip hazards for pedestrians.

deficits.evidence: There is a demand for crossing due to residential and commercial buildings on both sides, but no crossing facility is present.
deficits.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing at this location to facilitate safe crossing for pedestrians.

ratings.reason: The left side lacks a footway, but the suggestion is a generic standard measure and the available space is unclear.
Parked vehicles block the right-side path, but the suggestion is generic and the space for a proper footway is unclear.
The right-side path is uneven, but the suggestion is generic and the feasibility of repair is unclear.
No crossing is visible, but the suggestion is generic and the space for a marked crossing is unclear.
